title: Social Media Clan
case_use: User tweets an SVG → onboards to AI clan. Posts and likes control agent behavior stats.

title: Game Platform (AI + Payment)
case_use: User launches game. AI opponents via HF, payment per match, stream via Livepeer, agents moderate chat.
revenue_model: Match fee (10% platform). Cosmetic NFTs on Sui.
agent_benefit: Highest-engagement onboarding path. 50x conversion to MCP toolkit.

title: UNREAL Engine Toolbelt
case_use: UE developer installs plugin. Blueprint nodes for HF textures, Livepeer streams, social posts, agent search.
revenue_model: Plugin free. Per-tool-call fees via MCP bridge.
agent_benefit: Trojan horse into every UE project. Plugin = bridge client.

title: Onboarding by SVG
case_use: User posts SVG to X/Telegram. SVG contains base64 agent invitation + Sui payment intent. Webhook detects post → spawns agent.
revenue_model: Background wallet creation. First action micro-fee.
agent_benefit: Zero-friction onboarding. SVG IS the application.

title: MCP Tool Designer
case_use: User describes tool → agent chain designs, implements, packages as npm or single-file script. Hands user install command.
revenue_model: Premium tools (paid). Open tools (free, grow registry).
agent_benefit: Every tool = new registry entry. Users become contributors.

title: Agent Feedback Loop
case_use: After every action, agent logs outcome. Adjusts complexity thresholds. Escalates if error rate > 30%. Chain becomes self-tuning.
revenue_model: None directly. Enables all other cycles.
agent_benefit: The chain itself becomes an agent. Evolution without human tuning.

title: Payment Router
case_use: Every tool call has implicit cost. Router estimates, checks wallet, burns TROLLN or charges fiat, records in crystal chain.
agent_benefit: Payment data is training data for feedback loop.

title: Deterministic Agent Chain
case_use: Every task in ToDo-JobBoard is routed through model_router.py. Complexity → level → model → endpoint. Human flagged for Level 5.
agent_benefit: Prevents context collapse. Ensures right-sized compute.
